title: An Artificial Intelligence Model for Translating Natural Language into Functional De Novo Proteins.
authors: Riley, Timothy P; Parsa, Mohammad S; Kalantari, Pourya; Naderi, Ismail; Azimian, Kiana; Begloo, Nemya; Matusovsky, Oleg; Osher, Eliot; Prabhakaran, Devika; Yadav, Rahul; Simelis, Klem; Mathavan, Indran; Singh, Jeeven; Azimian, Kooshiar; Wei, Kathy Y
one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于Transformer的MP4模型，将自然语言提示直接映射为功能性从头设计蛋白序列，并通过实验验证了其可表达、热稳定及新折叠结构，属于蛋白质序列设计领域的AI方法创新，与课题高度相关。
abstract: Traditional protein design is fundamentally constrained by known sequences and folds. To break free from these limitations, we introduce a new alternative: designing proteins directly from plain-language specifications. To achieve this, we trained MP4, a transformer-based model that maps natural language prompts to protein sequences, on a dataset of 3.2 billion points and 138k tokens. In a benchmark of 96 prompts representing a wide array of functions and contexts, MP4 excelled by simultaneously improving on three key metrics: sequence realism, predicted fold quality, and alignment to the requested function. This high performance is particularly significant as it was achieved using only text as input which is a major departure from other models. Experimental validation confirmed our computational predictions: two de novo designs were experimentally shown to be both expressible and thermostable, with high-resolution crystallography (1.30 A and 1.77 A) ultimately revealing one to possess a paradigm-shifting novel fold. Functionally, the designs were also active, demonstrating both ATP binding and hydrolysis in vitro. This work demonstrates the realization of natural-language intent as functional proteins that express, crystallize, and catalyze. Although the underlying approach is still in early development with incomplete coverage and controllability, MP4 delivers a profound impact: it lowers the barrier to protein design and vastly expands the space for creative exploration in molecular programming.
abstract_zh: 传统蛋白质设计从根本上受限于已知序列和折叠结构。为突破这些限制，我们引入了一种新的替代方案：直接从自然语言规格说明设计蛋白质。为此，我们在包含32亿个数据点和138k个标记的数据集上训练了MP4，这是一种基于Transformer的模型，能将自然语言提示映射到蛋白质序列。在代表广泛功能和情境的96个提示基准测试中，MP4通过同时提升三个关键指标而表现出色：序列真实性、预测折叠质量以及与所请求功能的对齐程度。这一高性能尤为显著，因为它仅使用文本作为输入，这与其他模型有重大区别。实验验证证实了我们的计算预测：两个从头设计在实验中被证明既可表达又具有热稳定性，高分辨率晶体学（1.30 Å和1.77 Å）最终揭示其中一个具有范式转变的新颖折叠结构。在功能上，这些设计也具有活性，在体外展示了ATP结合和水解能力。这项工作证明了自然语言意图能实现为功能性蛋白质，这些蛋白质可表达、结晶并催化反应。尽管所采用的方法仍处于早期开发阶段，覆盖范围和可控性尚不完善，但MP4带来了深远影响：它降低了蛋白质设计的门槛，并极大扩展了分子编程中创造性探索的空间。
